title: Chapter 763
paragraphs: Chapter 763
Episode 187. People to Find, Unexpected Clues (4)
Kinzelo headquarters was quickly put on emergency alert.
They had no intention to do so, but if Jin had come to launch a surprise attack, it was only natural that the headquarters could be instantly turned into rubble.
In an instant, battle beasts and demons appeared, blowing the horn to announce the intrusion.
They drew their weapons to aim, but like the previous Jeokho gatekeepers, most of them couldn't dare to wield them.
Jin didn't miss the fact that among them, there were demons he hadn't seen in Hyungshinjeon.
'Did they already replenish their demons after Hyungshinjeon? Or are these forces that they didn't send out and kept hidden?'
There were a few demons that gave quite a hefty impression. A few years ago, they would have been formidable enough for Jin to have a hard time, or even be unable to defeat.
Of course, to the current Jin, they were simply cute, but they could be a sufficient threat to allies with relatively lower combat power.
Moreover, there was a high probability that the demons had special abilities like super regeneration or dark magic.

'Of course, the glances looking at me who suddenly showed up aren't exactly friendly. If I get the chance, it wouldn't be bad to check their levels for my comrades. I wish a few of them would come out and attack.'
Just as he thought that far, a demon blocked the way of Jin's group with glaring eyes.
The physique equivalent to the Baekrang tribe and the huge axe were impressive.
Jin was almost grateful and nearly thanked him.
"Jin Runcandel, what kind of nonsense is this?"
The demon shouted as if he was about to rush at him any second.
"What nonsense have I done?"
"I heard that the temporary alliance your chief made with you has ended. But you come to the headquarters without permission and brazenly seek the chief? Do you think this is reasonable behavior?"
Although it was undeniably correct, Jin shrugged his shoulders.
"Your chief and I are close enough to have a cup of tea anytime."
"You're playing with words...!"
"Enough."
Another demon stepped forward from the giant demon. The one with a calm gaze in a quaint outfit gave off a much more dangerous atmosphere than the giant one.
"You're not of his rank. Step aside."
"Understood."
When the giant stepped aside, the demon locked eyes with Jin.
"I am Shagal of the Bachma family."
The Four Great Dukes of the Underworld, Rontelgius, Caligo, Halovich, and Bachma. Shagal was the first son of Bachma.
"Ah, Lord Shagal! Please kill that bastard quickly!"
"Yes, Brother Shagal! Teach him a lesson!"
Bubare and Ainas, who had stealthily followed Jin's group, shouted out. Ignoring them, Bachma continued to speak.

"I was curious about you and now we meet for the first time. Could I ask you something? Now that the head of the Runcandel is absent, you are essentially the greatest sword of humanity, they say. And with the power of the Myungwang tribe's Tushin, you might be the true greatest sword."
Shagal drew his sword from his waist without waiting for Jin's response.
"Who said so?"
"Everyone did."
"I see. And where do you stand in the Underworld?"
"The greatest sword of the Underworld."
"That doesn't seem likely."
"...Let's just say I am within the top ten swordsmen who aspire to be so. Anyway, the Chief is currently in a meeting. It would be nice if you could join me until then."
It seems like there are a lot of eccentric individuals in the Underworld, Jin nodded understandingly. Shagal gave a smile as if asking Jin to draw his sword quickly.
"Your Grace, I am all set."
"Then you can start. You surely wouldn't ask for my instruction and expect me to make the first move."
Shagal's eyes widened. Jin's two swords were still at his waist. The nearby beasts and demons, gathered and tensed, waited for Shagal's response.
"I'm looking forward to this even more."
Whoosh!
Suddenly, Shagal disappeared from Jin's view. He hadn't simply moved fast and lost him, his body had turned into grey smoke in an instant.
'Dark magic? Or a kind of power?'
The smoky Shagal was suddenly thrusting his sword from behind Jin.
Swoosh!
Jin turned around and swung his fist to parry the incoming blade. Shagal's posture collapsed, revealing an opening.
Jin's fist, after parrying the sword, changed direction to strike Shagal's face. There should have been a sound like smashing iron, but the fist only hit the air.
'This is more of a power. Reminds me of Ozdok. Physical attacks didn't work on him either, but he couldn't help being exposed to impact when he attacked.'
However, Jin did not miss the moment Shagal was forming again on his left, and he drove his foot deep into Shagal's calf.
"Uh!"
Then, Jin grabbed Shagal's nape and slammed him to the ground. Shagal immediately turned into smoke to put distance between them. His shin was caved in, and his face was covered with dirt.
"Don't over-rely on your tricks."
Jin, who seemed to have no intention of further engagement, straightened his clothes.
The duel ended before even three seconds had passed.
"And always do your best when facing a stronger opponent. Was this enough of a lesson?"
Shagal blinked his eyes.
Of course, Shagal didn't think he could defeat Jin. According to what he had heard from Orgal and Kinzelo, to defeat Jin, at least the Dukes, including his own father, would have to step forward.
But he didn't expect to be suppressed so quickly. He had at least anticipated a proper fight. As Jin said, his complacency under the spell of his power was a critical cause.
"Sh-Shagal! You're not going to admit defeat already, are you?"
"Lord Shagal! No, does this mean Lord Shagal lost to Ranke too?"
Shagal briefly looked at the two with a contemptuous gaze, then nodded to Jin.
"...So be it."
Because the duel ended so quickly, Jin had to wait for Orgal's meeting to end.
Shagal personally escorted Jin's group to the guest room. Despite saving his face, he didn't show any excitement or roughness.
"But Shagal."
"What is it."
"If there's a takeaway, there should be a give back. I taught you something, so I want to ask you something I'm curious about."
"Aren't you already rude enough to visit here without notice?"
"Not enough. According to you, you learned the sword from someone close to the greatest sword of humanity…"
After a moment of consideration, Shagal nodded to Jin's reasonable words.
"You have a point. What are you curious about?"
"After the past Holy Kingdom Guardian War, I heard that the Underworld suffered damage close to annihilation. But there are still many powerful beings like you, Bianca, and Ranke left?"
"The Underworld is not one."
It was the first time Jin heard this.
"What does that mean?"
"I will answer up to here."
"Will you tell more if I teach you more about the sword?"
"I'll decline, Your Grace. Have some tea. It's precious."
At Shagal's firm attitude, Jin asked no more.
'The Underworld is not one…'

The statement could be interpreted in several ways. It could mean that the Underworld is not united, or that it is divided into several dimensions. There isn't much known about the Underworld after the Holy Kingdom Guardian War.
"Yes, the demonic relic our Holy Kingdom is preserving, the Eye of Zito, is showing some bad omens recently."
"The Eye of Zito?"

"The name Zito might be unfamiliar. He never acted in humanity and even in the Underworld, few people know his name. Even after becoming the Holy King, I could not confirm the records about the Eye of Zito."
"[To answer your question, hehe. Zito is a personification of punishment for us demons. But to me, he is no different from a master.]"
The conversation he had with Lani before the grotesque ceremony came to mind.
"It sounds like the Underworld ruled by your leader, Orgal, and the space where Demon King Zito ruled are separated. Is it just territorial separation, or are the dimensions different?"
Trying to see if he could get something from nothing, Shagal was startled and spit out his tea.
"Cough, choke."
"Is it that surprising?"
Orgal did not tell the other demons that Jin had mentioned Demon King Zito.

"Hmm, indeed, Your Grace has an extraordinary talent for surprising people... It seems the meeting has ended as the scribes are coming out. Go see the leader. I hope I can have a better fight with Your Grace next time."
When Shagal left the room as if running away, the party moved to Orgal.
"You have come, Jin Runcandel, the wizard of Hister. Bale, you are very welcome."
"Don't act friendly. I don't like you."
"I'm not in a good mood today, Jin Runcandel. So there must be a good reason for you to visit our headquarters without any pretext."
Bale answered, but Orgal showed discomfort towards Jin.
"What if there is no valid reason?"
[Then I will draw my sword. You will have to as well.]
"You sound threatening. I came to propose a different condition for the failed steel trade."
[If that's all, one of us will not be able to sleep soundly tonight. So, let's listen to the conditions of the steel trade after the remaining story is finished.]
Orgal seemed ready to draw his sword. His hand was already on the sword handle.

Even the scenery of what was a meeting room just a moment ago changed to a golden void. Orgal had prepared the battlefield using his power. Jin was momentarily baffled by the unexpected development, but he calmly looked at Orgal.

'It seems he's not just in a bad mood, but in a horribly bad state. What could have infuriated Orgal, one of the most cautious among the mostly mad Kinzelo? It couldn't have been because of my declaration.'
He was not scared, but it was not the time to fight him.
However, depending on the value of the bait Jin had prepared before coming, there was a possibility that a real battle could occur.
"Lokia Ganesto."
[...What?]
"I came here to inquire why the traitor from a thousand years ago, wants the resurrection of the sun god, just like you."
Slowly, Orgal's hand, which had been on the sword handle, came down.
